AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Nutrition.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Nutrition.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Nutrition.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Disease Control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Disease Control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Disease Control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Disease Control.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Cropping? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Cropping.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Cropping.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Cropping.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Cropping.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Urban and peri-urban Agriculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Breeding? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Breeding.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Breeding.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Breeding.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agri- business Accounts? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agri- business Accounts.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Agri- business Accounts.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agri- business Accounts.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agri- business Accounts.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Breeding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Disease Control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. D — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Cropping.

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.

10. C — Ice melting to water

11. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.
